title: Challenge 66：什么时候重装原子真正有帮助？
lede: 在 1.92 亿次已验收 cell-shots 中，动态重装产生了 502 个暂定正面、0 个有害的 FDR 分类；独立种子确认的 32/32 个比较通过精度门，严格停止规则则保留了科学结论的边界。

sections.title: Challenge
sections.note: 原子丢失不是普通 Pauli 错误：载体离开阵列后，空位会跨纠错轮累积。重装可以恢复硬件占用，却不能恢复原子丢失前的未知量子态。

blocks.text: 本研究比较四类策略：不重装、检测后立即重装、每隔 R 轮周期重装，以及缺失比例超过阈值后集中重装。问题不是“能不能补原子”，而是重装带来的占用恢复能否在逻辑层面超过等待、复位错误和失败重试的代价。
中性原子平台天然面对 loss，而表面码能够利用“已知在哪里丢失”的擦除信息。一个可复现的策略区域基准可以直接连接器件调度、容错架构和未来 learned decoder 的数据接口。

pairs: #66 · How much does atom reloading help loss-tolerant surface-code memory?
yanwang · 王介人、何思成、赵志轩

sections.title: Approach
sections.note: 所有策略在同一 shot 上共享逐轮、逐位置、逐事件类型的外生随机数；差值因此主要反映策略决策，而不是两批独立样本的运气。

blocks.text: Finite-size paired Monte Carlo · deterministic replay

pairs: Round-level circuit Monte Carlo + erasure-aware MWPM
Counter-addressed streams keyed by shot, round, site and event
Paired 95% CI · 20,000 bootstrap resamples · BH FDR q = 0.05
Future loss and logical labels excluded from policy/decoder input

blocks.text: 每个站点遵循 ACTIVE → LOST_UNDETECTED → LOST_DETECTED → RELOADING → ACTIVE 状态机。解码器读取已经揭示的 loss/reload history 来重建时变擦除图。独立穷举 oracle、标签投毒、负向控制、故障注入和不可变 checksum manifest 共同约束实现错误与信息泄漏。

items.caption: Causal paired benchmark. Four reload policies see the same addressed external noise; only revealed history enters the common erasure-aware decoder, and policy effects are measured with paired intervals.

sections.title: Results
sections.note: 最强结果是“存在参数区域信号且独立精度已达标”；最严格的全网格停止门仍未完成，因此没有事后挑选一个普适赢家。

blocks.text: 1 · Discovery：正面信号覆盖四分之一的配对比较

items.caption: Promising but provisional. Across all 1,960 public policy-versus-none comparisons, 502 are FDR-qualified as helpful, 1,458 show no significant difference, and none are classified harmful at Phase 3.

blocks.label: Promising parameter-region signal
blocks.why: 502/1,960 comparisons favor active reload after paired FDR correction; 276/280 lockstep groups still require continuation.

items.caption: Passed precision gate. Every independent-seed comparison reaches the registered confidence-interval width, exceeding the required 80% fraction; the separate logical-failure event-count gate remains incomplete.

blocks.label: Independent precision gate passed
blocks.why: 32/32 comparisons meet precision, for a fraction of 1.0 against the registered 0.8 requirement.

blocks.text: 3 · Evidence：两条独立工作流均有可复核 artifact

items.caption: Checksum-verified evidence. Discovery and independent confirmation contribute 179.2M and 12.8M accepted cell-shots respectively; the 192M total describes engineering volume and is not pooled as one statistical sample.

blocks.label: Deadline disposition
blocks.text: `inconclusive_at_deadline` is retained. Phase 3 strengthens the public evidence after the frozen deadline but does not retroactively authorize a headline winner. Cost sensitivity was not started and the sealed holdout remains 0/1.

sections.title: Highlight
sections.note: 这项工作的价值不只是一组 Monte Carlo 数字，而是把动态硬件修复变成一个可因果比较、可恢复运行、可独立审计的量子纠错基准。

blocks.text: **策略与噪声解耦。** Counter-addressed common random numbers 让所有策略经历相同外生事件，避免“某策略碰巧抽到更容易样本”的伪改进。
**动态擦除进入解码图。** 缺失掩码不是只保存到文件，而是按每轮已知 loss history 构造 super-stabilizer / erasure-aware matching graph。
**失败也可审计。** Checkpoint、atomic publish、checksum manifest 和 fail-closed resume 保证超算超时不会把半成品混入科学结果。
502 个 helpful 与 0 个 harmful 暂定分类说明主动重装不是一个边缘效应，值得继续定位它的适用参数区间。独立 confirmation 的 32/32 精度成功又表明，当前主要缺口是保守事件计数，而不是估计完全不稳定。
版本化的 syndrome + missing/reload history + metadata 输入接口可以直接服务未来的 MWPM 改进或 learned decoder，同时保持 logical label 隔离。它也提供了连接中性原子 telemetry、部分可观测控制和相关 loss 模型的基础。

blocks.label: Claim boundary
blocks.text: 本结果支持“动态重装在部分参数区间有潜在收益”，不支持“某一策略在所有噪声下普遍最优”，也不把 d=3,5 的有限尺寸现象称为渐近阈值。
